items.reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:74-86, an English resource loads itself as the reference, producing identical normalized values. Lines 150-155 therefore strip matching anchors, including javascript: hrefs, before the sanitizer runs at lines 88-92, so unsafe English anchors escape the newly added validation. This is a security weakness requiring an unsafe anchor in an English resource.
